newsitem.title: USA: Sigma-Aldrich sees profit margins consistent.
newsitem.headline: Sigma-Aldrich sees profit margins consistent.

text.p: Sigma-Aldrich Corp said Thursday it expected profit margins for the remainder of 1997 to be consistent with first six month levels as the company continues to improve productivity and control costs.
The chemical manufacturer reported gross profit of $302 million and net income of $82.1 million for the first six months of the year on sales of $557.6 million.
The company also said currency exchange rates may continue to moderate its chemical business growth rates.
But future chemical sales will benefit fromt he company's participation in the Riedel-de Haen partnership , the company said.
Earlier Thursday, Sigma-Aldrich reported net income of $40.7 million, or $0.41 a share, in the second quarter, compared to $37.0 million, or $0.37 a share, a year ago.
Sigma-Aldrich shares closed up 1/4 at 34-1/8 Thursday.
